original_value: Recently, pose or attribute information has been widely used to solve person re-identification (re-ID) problem. However, the inaccurate output from pose or attribute modules will impair the final person re-ID performance. Since re-ID, pose estimation and attribute recognition are all based on the person appearance information, we propose a Local-refining based Deep Neural Network (LRDNN) to aggregate pose estimation and attribute recognition to improve the re-ID performance. To this end, we add a pose branch to extract the local spatial information and optimize the whole network on both person identity and attribute objectives. To diminish the negative affect from unstable pose estimation, a novel structure called channel parse block (CPB) is introduced to learn weights on different feature channels in pose branch. Then two branches are combined with compact bilinear pooling. Experimental results on Market1501 and DukeMTMC-reid datasets illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

result.paraphrase: Recently, pose and attribute information have been widely employed to address the person re-identification (re-ID) problem. However, inaccurate outputs from pose or attribute modules can hurt final re-ID performance. Because re-ID, pose estimation, and attribute recognition all rely on a person's appearance information, we propose a Local-refining based Deep Neural Network (LRDNN) that integrates pose estimation and attribute recognition to enhance re-ID performance. To this end, we introduce a pose branch to capture local spatial information and train the entire network using both person identity and attribute objectives. To reduce the adverse impact of unstable pose estimation, we add a novel channel parse block (CPB) structure to learn weights across different feature channels in the pose branch. The two branches are then fused with compact bilinear pooling. Experimental results on the Market1501 and DukeMTMC-reid datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
